name: Design Warehouse
old_description: Discover American Leather where modern comfort meets precision craftsmanship. Explore our curated selection of customizable sofas, sectionals, recliners, and sofa sleepers, all made to order in Dallas, Texas. With sustainable practices, premium materials, and timeless silhouettes, American Leather delivers tailored performance without sacrificing style.
about:
Design Warehouse has operated as a Santa Fe, New Mexico institution since 1981. The retailer maintains hours Monday through Saturday and offers validated parking for visitors at its Lincoln Avenue location.

The business curates a selection of furniture, lamps, and home accessories for residential customers. Its showroom presents bedroom settings, couch and coffee table displays, dining room tables, and desks. The product assortment includes lines such as the Garden Party Wardrobe System in Oblivion and White finishes. Orders are fulfilled through USPS for smaller items and common carrier for furniture, with all web and furniture sales marked final. Shipping costs are tiered by order value, with free shipping on orders over $100.

The store serves individual consumers rather than industrial or commercial buyers. Local Flavor Magazine has described it as the place in town for artfully designed home furnishings, noting elegant bedroom settings and sleek contemporary displays.

The company emphasizes personal service, stating a preference for phone communication and providing direct contact for shipping quotes to 47 states.
